record.hypothesis: Drain already published application completions before ring submission to remove an eventfd-CQE round trip when socket work is already ready.
record.decision: Uncapped p99 improves in all three pairs, but paced p99 worsens in all three, throughput ties in both workloads, and CPU ranges overlap. Paced median CPU falls 2.8%; uncapped median CPU rises 0.34%. Reject the tail tradeoff and retain V2.

record.goal: Stopped at user request; strict superiority on every metric was not achieved. Unresolved comparisons and ties are archived.
record.acceptance: V2 connection buffers and bounded public TCP retries remain. Higher GET p50 is accepted in three workloads with lower p99. Other unfavorable comparisons and all ties remain open.
constraints: Unresolved ties and unfavorable results remain documented; user ended the investigation before the strict all-metrics target was achieved.
